The die moves according to the sequence

\[
1\to2\to3\to4\to5\to6\to7:
\qquad \text{right, right, up, right, up, right}.
\]

Label the six faces initially at position \(1\) as \(b,t,n,s,e,w\), according to their initial bottom, top, north, south, east, and west positions.

- When rolling right, the old east face becomes the new bottom.
- When rolling up, the old north face becomes the new bottom.

Tracking all six faces gives:

\[
\begin{array}{c|cccccc}
\text{Position}&\text{Bottom}&\text{Top}&\text{North}&\text{South}&\text{East}&\text{West}\\ \hline
1&b&t&n&s&e&w\\
2&e&w&n&s&t&b\\
3&t&b&n&s&w&e\\
4&n&s&b&t&w&e\\
5&w&e&b&t&s&n\\
6&b&t&e&w&s&n\\
7&s&n&e&w&t&b
\end{array}
\]

Thus the bottom faces are

\[
b,e,t,n,w,b,s,
\]

so the same physical face \(b\) is on the bottom at positions \(1\) and \(6\).

\[
\boxed{\text{B: 1 and 6}}
\]
